def find_connected_components(grid):
    """Find all connected components of non-background pixels."""
    if not grid or not grid[0]:

    h, w = len(grid), len(grid[0])
    visited = set()
    components = defaultdict(list)
    
    for i in range(h):

            val = grid[i][j]

                stack = [(i,j)]
